result.title: An important Bottleneck in LLM Optimizers: Principle-Level Local Optima
result.summary: Feedback-driven LLM optimizers are increasingly used for evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, heuristic design, and scientific discovery. Yet rapid initial gains often give way to prolonged plateaus despite substantial remaining evaluation budgets. We investigate \emph{principle-level search collapse}, where an optimizer's search becomes confined to a narrow set of design principles, even though it may continue to generate distinct candidates and achieve small improvements. We assemble a diagnostic benchmark spanning molecular optimization, network sentinel-node selection, and GPU-kernel optimization, and introduce a decision-tree protocol combining principle narrowing, prolonged performance plateaus, and gaps to attainable reference solutions. Across 161 assessable runs on the three problem domains, 78.3\% receive support for collapse, including 55.3\% with strong support. Candidate-level variation can nevertheless conceal restricted search at the principle level. We then test \emph{diversity injection}, a common response to search stagnation, such as higher t, multiple LLMs, and web search, and show that it provides limited and inconsistent benefits: among 65 molecular runs, still 73.8\% and 53.8\% receive support and strong support respectively. We finally test reference-principle interventions and find that they improve some runs, but their benefits vary across models and tasks: access to a better principle does not guarantee its effective use. Our benchmark and diagnostic protocol provide a basis for evaluating future optimizers on principle-level collapse. Our findings highlight the need for online collapse detection and better mechanisms for generating and maintaining alternative principles during optimization.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究反馈驱动 LLM 优化器中的「原则级搜索崩溃」：优化器虽持续产出不同候选，却把搜索限制在少数设计原则内，收益停滞。作者构建跨分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择与 GPU kernel 优化的诊断基准和决策树协议，并检验多样性注入与参考原则干预的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心判断「候选层差异会掩盖原则层搜索受限」与 LVR 中潜在假设的多样性维持、崩溃检测和评价方式可能概念相通，且多样性注入收益有限的负结果可供核查；但论文面向黑盒优化而非视觉多模态推理，联系需自行判断。
